.`restoreNote clears deletedAt and resurfaces the note`()
.`togglePin on blank draft keeps the note instead of deleting it`()
.`searchNotes falls back to all notes when query has only operators`()
.`toFtsMatchQuery strips operators and appends prefix wildcard`()
